description_en: Provides a one-stop AI image processing service for e-commerce sellers. Orchestrates six atomic capabilities—element recognition, intelligent cutout, intelligent erasure, image translation Pro, intelligent cropping, and high-definition upscaling—into an image processing workflow. Users can upload an image once, select the required capabilities, and complete multiple image optimizations in sequence to output product images that meet the requirements of e-commerce platforms. (Asynchronous)
description_zh: 面向电商卖家的一站式 AI 图片智能处理服务。将元素识别、智能抠图、智能消除、图片翻译 Pro、智能裁剪、高清放大六项原子能力编排为图片处理工作流，用户只需一次上传图片、勾选所需能力，即可按顺序一次性完成多项图片优化，输出符合铺货平台要求的商品图。（异步）
name: VisionFlow

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image to be processed. Required. The resolution must be greater than 256×256, the long side must not exceed 1920 pixels, and the short side must not exceed 1080 pixels. The size must not exceed 5 MB. Supported formats include PNG, JPEG, JPG, BMP, and WEBP
parameters.help_zh: 待处理图片URL，必填。分辨率应大于256×256，长边不大于1920像素，短边不大于1080像素；大小不超过5MB；支持png、jpeg、jpg、bmp、webp
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The AI capabilities to be processed. Multiple values are supported. Valid values: 1 (Intelligent element recognition), 2 (Intelligent cutout), 3 (Intelligent erasure), 4 (Image translation Pro), 5 (Intelligent cropping), and 6 (High-definition upscaling)
parameters.help_zh: 选择需要处理的AI能力（1=智能元素识别，2=智能抠图，3=智能消除，4=图片翻译Pro，5=智能裁剪，6=高清放大），可多选
parameters.name: ability

parameters.help_en: The elements to detect on the image subject. Multiple values are supported. Valid values: 1 (Watermark), 2 (Logo), 3 (Text), and 4 (Text block). When the intelligent element recognition capability is selected, at least one of this parameter and NonobjectDetectElements must be specified
parameters.help_zh: 检测图片主体上的元素（1=水印；2=Logo；3=文字；4=含字色块），可多选。选择智能元素识别能力时，与NonobjectDetectElements至少有一项必填
parameters.name: object_detect_elements

parameters.help_en: The elements to detect on the non-subject area of the image. Multiple values are supported. Valid values: 1 (Watermark), 2 (Logo), 3 (Text), and 4 (Text block). When the intelligent element recognition capability is selected, at least one of this parameter and ObjectDetectElements must be specified
parameters.help_zh: 检测非图片主体上的元素（1=水印；2=Logo；3=文字；4=含字色块），可多选。选择智能元素识别能力时，与ObjectDetectElements至少有一项必填
parameters.name: nonobject_detect_elements

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include images with the specified elements in subsequent processing. A value of true indicates that images with the elements are included in subsequent processing. A value of false indicates that images with the elements are not included. Required when the intelligent element recognition capability is selected
parameters.help_zh: 选择带有此元素的图片进入后续处理还是不带。true表示带有元素的图片进入后续处理，false表示不带。选择智能元素识别能力时必填
parameters.name: is_filter

parameters.help_en: The background type of the returned image. Valid values: WHITE_BACKGROUND (White background image) and TRANSPARENT (Transparent background image). Required when the intelligent cutout capability is selected
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回的图像背景形式。取值：WHITE_BACKGROUND（白底图）、TRANSPARENT（透明图）。选择智能抠图能力时必填
parameters.name: back_ground_type

parameters.help_en: The elements to remove from the image subject. Multiple values are supported. Valid values: 1 (Transparent text block), 2 (Specific name), 3 (Text), and 4 (Cluttered text). When the intelligent erasure capability is selected, at least one of this parameter and NonobjectRemoveElements must be specified
parameters.help_zh: 去除图片主体上的元素（1=透明字块；2=特定名称；3=文字；4=牛皮癣），可多选。选择智能消除能力时，与NonobjectRemoveElements至少有一项必填
parameters.name: object_remove_elements

parameters.help_en: The elements to remove from the non-subject area of the image. Multiple values are supported. Valid values: 1 (Transparent text block), 2 (Specific name), 3 (Text), and 4 (Cluttered text). When the intelligent erasure capability is selected, at least one of this parameter and ObjectRemoveElements must be specified
parameters.help_zh: 去除图片非主体上的元素（1=透明字块；2=特定名称；3=文字；4=牛皮癣），可多选。选择智能消除能力时，与ObjectRemoveElements至少有一项必填
parameters.name: nonobject_remove_elements

parameters.help_en: The specific erasure area in Run-Length Encoding (RLE) format. Optional. If this parameter is specified, it takes precedence and the ObjectRemoveElements and NonobjectRemoveElements parameters are ignored
parameters.help_zh: 具体的消除区域，RLE格式，选填。若传入将优先使用，忽略ObjectRemoveElements和NonobjectRemoveElements参数
parameters.name: mask

parameters.help_en: The source language code. Optional. For supported language pairs, see the list of supported translation languages
parameters.help_zh: 源语言代码，选填。支持的语向见翻译支持语向列表
parameters.name: source_language

parameters.help_en: The target language code. Optional. For supported language pairs, see the list of supported translation languages
parameters.help_zh: 目标语言代码，选填。支持的语向见翻译支持语向列表
parameters.name: target_language

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to translate text on the image subject. Optional. Default value: false. This parameter helps protect embedded information such as product names from being translated
parameters.help_zh: 是否翻译图片主体上文字，选填，默认false。可帮助保护商品名称等嵌入信息避免被翻译
parameters.name: including_product_area

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to translate brand names in the image. Optional. Default value: false. This parameter helps protect brand name information from being translated
parameters.help_zh: 是否翻译图片上的品牌名，选填，默认false。可帮助保护品牌名信息避免被翻译
parameters.name: translating_brand_in_the_product

parameters.help_en: The ID of the intervention glossary. Optional. You must create the glossary in the console and provide its ID. If this parameter is left empty, the translation results are not modified
parameters.help_zh: 干预词表ID，选填。需在前台单独创建并提供其ID。如果为空则翻译结果不会被修改
parameters.name: glossary

parameters.help_en: The expected width of the cropped image, in pixels. Valid values: 100 to 5000. Required when the intelligent cropping capability is selected
parameters.help_zh: 期望裁剪成的图片宽度，单位像素，取值100-5000。选择智能裁剪能力时必填
parameters.name: target_width

parameters.help_en: The expected height of the cropped image, in pixels. Valid values: 100 to 5000. Required when the intelligent cropping capability is selected
parameters.help_zh: 期望裁剪成的图片高度，单位像素，取值100-5000。选择智能裁剪能力时必填
parameters.name: target_height

parameters.help_en: The image upscaling factor. Optional. Default value: 2. Valid values: 2 to 4. Required when the high-definition upscaling capability is selected
parameters.help_zh: 图像放大倍数，选填，默认2倍，取值范围2-4。选择高清放大能力时必填
parameters.name: upscale_factor

Code.description_en: The status code. If the call is successful, "success" is returned
Code.description_zh: 状态码，正常调用时返回"success"

Data.description_en: The submission result data of the asynchronous task, which includes the asynchronous task ID
Data.description_zh: 异步任务提交结果数据，包含异步任务ID

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous task, which is used to query the processing result by calling QueryAsyncTaskResult
TaskId.description_zh: 异步任务ID，用于后续通过QueryAsyncTaskResult查询处理结果
TaskId.title_en: 异步任务ID，用于后续查询结果
TaskId.title_zh: 异步任务ID，用于后续查询结果

Message.description_en: The error message. If the call is successful, "Success" is returned
Message.description_zh: 报错信息。正常调用时返回"Success"

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to identify a unique request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用来识别唯一一次请求调用

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. A value of true indicates success, and a value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 是否调用成功。true代表成功，false代表失败
